sections.heading: Fluffy. Moist. Straight from the oven.
body: Słodko Mi is a small bakery in Poznań's Wilda district that does one thing and does it properly: cinnamon rolls. Every morning we make the dough from scratch, roll each cinnamon roll by hand and bake everything the same day.
Cynamonki, cinnamon rolls, cinnamon buns — call them what you like. We have 7 flavours, plus coffee to go with them: enjoy it here or take it away.

sections.heading: Pop over to Wilda – directions and hours.
sections.intro: You'll find us in Wilda, Poznań, at ul. 28 Czerwca 1956 r. 177/13 — the entrance is on ul. Hetmańska. There's a public transport stop right next door, so that's the easiest way to get here. We're open Tuesday to Sunday; on Mondays we take a rest.

image.alt: Cinnamon rolls packed to take away in white boxes

items.question: Where are you, and where's the entrance?
items.answer: In Wilda, Poznań, at ul. 28 Czerwca 1956 r. 177/13. The entrance is on Hetmańska Street (ul. Hetmańska) — you can't get in from the 28 Czerwca side.

items.question: Do you deliver?
items.answer: Yes — you can order our cinnamon rolls for delivery on Wolt. Or drop by and pick them up from us in Wilda.

items.question: How many cinnamon roll flavours do you have?
items.answer: Seven: classic with icing, classic with cream cheese, Biscoff, Oreo, szarlotka (Polish apple pie) with crumble and caramel, sernik (Polish cheesecake) with strawberry and crumble, and raspberry with coconut.

items.question: Are your cinnamon rolls fresh?
items.answer: Every morning we make the dough from scratch, roll each cinnamon roll by hand and bake everything the same day.

items.question: Do you serve coffee?
items.answer: Yes, we serve coffee with our cinnamon rolls — to drink here or to take away.

items.question: Can I order a bigger batch of cinnamon rolls?
items.answer: Of course. Message us on Instagram or give us a call, and let us know how many you'd like and for what time — we'll have them ready.

items.question: Are you open on Sundays? And on Mondays?
items.answer: On Sundays, yes! We're open Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00–19:00, and closed on Mondays. Hours may differ on public holidays — we post any changes next to our opening hours and on Google.

items.question: Can I eat in?
items.answer: Of course — enjoy your cinnamon roll and coffee here with us, or take them away.
